bio.overview: Charlie Dominici was the original lead singer of Dream Theater, contributing to their early development and first official album 'When Dream and Day Unite'.
extended_bio: Joined Dream Theater (then called Majesty) in 1987 as their first official vocalist
Recorded vocals for the band's debut album 'When Dream and Day Unite' (1989)
Left the band in 1989 due to creative differences, later pursuing solo projects

trivia.did_you_know: Dominici returned to collaborate with Dream Theater members on a progressive rock trilogy decades after leaving the band.
